messages:
support-alex: FYI customer ACME (prod, us-west-2) just opened a ticket — p95/p99 jumped after last night's batcher tweak. They report intermittent 5xx/429 and slow responses. Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ACME-912 :eyes:
rajesh: ugh. saw a spike in p99 around 1769992000 in telemetry. p95 went 120ms -> ~460ms, p99 to ~2.4s. Also a cluster of 429s for the same tenant around the spike window.
maria: which change was rolled? deploy-bot: rolled config: continuous-batcher v2 -> policy_v3 at 1769950000 (author: ops-automation).
chris: policy_v3 increased max_batch_size and grace window to improve throughput for large models — suspect tail for small prompts.
rajesh: config diff (from infra logs):
```
- max_batch_size: 32
- max_wait_ms: 50
- coalesce_window_ms: 8
+ max_batch_size: 64
+ max_wait_ms: 200
+ coalesce_window_ms: 20
```
rajesh: notices: small prompt traffic (short LLM requests) ends up waiting for batch fill -> increases latency variance and triggers auth refresh/billing rate limits because retries pile up.
support-alex: I have the customer's request ids: [req/ACME/147, req/ACME/158, req/ACME/160] — they saw 429 then a 500 after retry.
maria: can we repro locally with a small prompt workload? quick script to simulate:
```
for i in {1..200}; do curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"input":"hi"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate &
 done; wait
```
rajesh: ran a synthetic run on staging with the policy_v3 config, reproduced p99 ~2.1s. Logs show many batches of size 1 held for ~180ms. snippet:
```
[coalescer] held_for_ms=182 batch_size=1 route=prod-realtime tenant=acme
[service] dispatch_latency_ms=2150 handler=token_auth status=200
[quota] rate_limit_check=ok retries=2
```
sre-oncall: we need a short mitigation to restore customer SLOs. Proposal: rollback max_wait_ms to 60 for prod, enable aggressive prefix KV cache, and put acme on a smaller-batch canary with previous config for 30m.
maria: agree. canary first, then rollback globally if green. I'll coordinate the canary. @rajesh can you prepare the rollback patch and a one-line feature-flag so we can toggle?
rajesh: on it. patch ready: `policy_v3_hotfix` sets `max_wait_ms: 60`, `max_batch_size: 48`, `coalesce_window_ms: 10`. Pushing canary to 3 nodes in us-west-2 now.
chris: added a temporary SKU guard to avoid billing 429 cascades: throttle client retries at the edge for 1m with exponential backoff.
rajesh: canary metrics after 6m: p95 back to ~140ms, p99 down to ~600ms for the canary nodes, no 429s recorded for ACME.
support-alex: forwarded canary results to customer; they asked for ETA to full rollback.
maria: recommend 30m observation, then full rollout rollback to hotfix. I will keep monitoring dashboards and set an alert for any auth 5xx spike.
sre-oncall: action items: @rajesh roll out hotfix globally at +30m if no regressions; @chris keep edge retry throttle for 1h; @maria follow up with ACME and close ticket if stable.
deploy-bot: started rollout `policy_v3_hotfix` -> 50% at 1769999100, 100% scheduled at 1769999400 (can be aborted).
rajesh: abort scheduled if we see any error >0.5% increase.
maria: one more thing — add a postmortem checklist entry: when increasing `max_wait_ms`, run small-prompt synthetic suite and tenant-isolation smoke tests.
support-alex: customer replied: "we're seeing much better numbers on the canary, thanks" :thumbsup:
chris: follow-up: I'll open a short doc in docs/platform/batching-risks.md with recommended safe limits and the quick rollback playbook.
maria: thanks all. will update ticket and close thread after full rollout. :white_check_mark:
